messages:
olivia_pm: Heads-up: partnership ask — we need to assemble a Datadog + OpenTelemetry observability bundle for the GPU inference marketplace listing. Deliverables: sample OTel collector config, trace sampling guidance for long-running model shards, dashboard JSON and a partner demo env. Target launch week May 12. Who can take lead?

raj_partner_eng: I can lead partner-eng on this. Need a clear list of deliverables and the Datadog tile specs. Do we want per-tenant token-cost metrics surfaced?

maria_observability: Yes — per-route token cost, p95 latency, NV GPU utilization, and KV-cache hit-rate are must-haves. I can draft the dashboards and queries.

aj_infra: We should provide both daemonset collector and a sidecar pattern. Starter OTEL collector config (daemonset) below: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "{{DD_API_KEY}}"
```
I'll add a helm values snippet for sidecar as well.

tom_b: For traces: recommend adaptive sampling by request length + errors. Rule: sample all error traces, sample 5% of short-inference requests (<200 tokens), and 20% of long-running ones (>2000 tokens). This keeps storage sane while preserving tail behavior.

nina_sre: Add alerting rules: token-cost spike (>2x baseline over 10m), cache-hit drop below 60% sustained 5m, sustained p99 latency regression >30%. I'll author a short runbook for oncall steps and rollback triggers.

olivia_pm: Awesome. Also coordinate announcement timing with marketing/legal — we'll need a screenshot of the Datadog tile + a 1-line blurb. Raj, can you own the partner marketing sync?

raj_partner_eng: On it. I'll create the demo Datadog org, generate a tile screenshot, and loop in growth. Will also create demo creds for the partner test org and a dedicated k8s namespace.

deploy-bot: env created: partner-demo-otel-1963456789 (k8s namespace), collector deployed (daemonset).

maria_observability: Uploading initial dashboard JSON to partners repo at repos/partner-monitoring/dd-otel-gpu/demo-dashboard.json — will post the PR link once it's up. Dashboard will include panels: token cost by route, p95/p99 latency, GPU util, kv-cache hit-rate, trace-sample explorer.

olivia_pm: :thumbsup: Next steps & owners: Raj = partner sync + demo creds, Maria = dashboard JSON + queries, Aj = OTEL config + install scripts, Nina = runbook & alerts. Can everyone ack with ETA?

raj_partner_eng: Ack — ETA: EOD Wed for partner sync and demo creds.

maria_observability: Ack — dashboard JSON PR by Thu noon.

aj_infra: Ack — OTEL config + helm values by Wed evening, will include install script.

nina_sre: Ack — runbook & alerts by Thu EOD, will include playbook for rollback to cpu-backed fallback.

olivia_pm: I'll schedule a 30m sync for Thu 10:00am PT and send invites. Please add any blockers to the doc I just shared. Thanks folks!
